What you see. Every part is the real STL of round r00 of cad/robot; no primitives, no plan. The moving parts (8 legs, 4 cranks, 3 idlers, the transfer gear and the pinion) move with the pose, as in verify.py. The warnings come from cad/robot/verify-result.txt (cad_verify), not from the fit check: they are listed on the right, with a marker where the two parts come closest at pose 0.
